stories.title: Series Preview — Blue Jays at Wrigley, 1:20 PM CT
stories.angle: Single-game interleague series at Wrigley Field. David Peterson vs. Dylan Cease, the $210M arm Toronto locked up this offseason. Cubs (66-49) vs. Blue Jays (54-61). Series-start protocol reserves this slot. Lead with matchup/location/length; pitcher stakes as kicker.

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Blue Jays at Wrigley. 1-game series. 1:20 PM CT.

David Peterson vs. Dylan Cease — the $210M arm Toronto locked up in the offseason. Cubs are 66-49. Blue Jays are 54-61.

Friendly Confines > a fat contract.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Cubs Sweep Dodgers — PCA Makes History
stories.angle: Cubs swept the Dodgers (Aug 3-5). PCA went 3-for-5, 2 HR, 4 RBI in the series clincher. Milestone: first Cubs player ever with consecutive 25 HR/25 SB seasons. Hoerner 3 hits. Ohtani homered twice but Cubs won. Dodgers now on 6-game losing streak, swept in back-to-back series. Cubs 32-15 since June 11. NO score in tweet per has_score=False insight.

x_posts.label: Post 2
x_posts.text:
Pete Crow-Armstrong did something no Cub has ever done — back-to-back 25 HR/25 SB seasons.

He went 3-for-5 with two homers and four RBI to cap the sweep of Ohtani and the Dodgers.

The MVP race has a new frontrunner.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: PCA MVP Case — Stat Breakdown
stories.angle: Deep dive on PCA's season line: .288 BA, 26 HR, 28 SB, 7.0+ fWAR (No. 1 MLB position players). OAA 22 (No. 1 MLB). 33 Statcast five-star catches (Era record). Ohtani limited to DH. PCA is the clear NL MVP frontrunner.

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
PCA through August 5: .288 BA, 26 HR, 28 SB, 7.0 fWAR — No. 1 among all MLB position players.

Also No. 1 in the league in Outs Above Average (22). His 33 Statcast five-star catches set a new Era record.

This isn't a hot streak. It's a level change.

#Cubs #ChicagoCubs #MLB

stories.title: Cardinals Free-Fall — Rival Watch
stories.angle: Cardinals at 54-57, 15th in NL WC — functionally eliminated. Cubs at 66-49, No. 1 NL Wild Card. Sharp rival jab angle: summer is over for St. Louis.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text:
Cardinals update: 54-57. 15th in NL Wild Card standings.

They've been functionally eliminated from the playoff picture for weeks.

Meanwhile, the Cubs sit at 66-49 — No. 1 NL Wild Card — and are just getting started.

#Cubs #NorthSiders #MLB

stories.title: Pre-Game Hype — Peterson vs Cease at Wrigley
stories.angle: Single game at Wrigley, 1:20 PM CT. Cubs (66-49) vs Blue Jays (54-61). David Peterson vs Dylan Cease (7yr/$210M). Only one of these teams is actually in the playoff race. Wrigley factor bold take.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text:
One game. Wrigley Field. 1:20 PM CT.

Cubs (66-49) host the Blue Jays (54-61) — only one of these teams is in the playoff race.

Dylan Cease is good. David Peterson and 40,000 Wrigley faithful are better.

#Cubs #GoCubs #FlyTheW

stories.title: Kevin Gausman — Cubs Debut Friday
stories.angle: Gausman officially activated Aug 5 (from deadline trade with Blue Jays). Antoine Kelly optioned. Cubs debut Friday at Kansas City Royals. Adds veteran arm to rotation behind Imanaga.

x_posts.label: Post 6
x_posts.text:
Kevin Gausman is officially a Cub — and he makes his debut FRIDAY in Kansas City.

The 35-year-old deadline pickup gives Chicago a proven veteran arm behind Imanaga at the top of the rotation.

The Cubs aren't done building.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #MLB

stories.title: Prospect Pipeline — Ayers, Wiggins, Bowser
stories.angle: Owen Ayers promoted to Triple-A Iowa (power-hitting catcher). Jaxon Wiggins working through command issues at Iowa (Aug 4 rough outing) but stuff is elite (97-98 mph, 19+ IVB). Drew Bowser hit first career grand slam with Knoxville Smokies.

x_posts.label: Post 7
x_posts.text:
Farm report: Owen Ayers promoted to Triple-A Iowa — the power-hitting catcher is one step from the Show.

Jaxon Wiggins is still ironing out command issues at Iowa, but the stuff is ELECTRIC. That fastball's going to be a problem for the NL someday.

#Cubs #CubsBaseball #GoCubs
